pages.title: Book and quests
pages.text: Use the **Whisker Codex** to learn a system before building it. Open the quest screen with the **Grave / backtick** key to see tasks, requirements and rewards. If you changed your controls, search Controls for Quests.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Start with this chapter. **The Loom Braid** explains the campaign stages. The story chapters are there when you want to learn about the world.

pages.title: Read, build, check
pages.text:
Each practical lesson gives you a goal, a short sequence and a way to check the result. Follow the arrows between entries.\
For exact crafting ingredients, hover an item in your inventory or the item list and open its recipe. Recipes can change with the pack; a build diagram shows placement, not a crafting recipe.

pages.title: Words used in thi...
pages.text:
**Pad:** your floating island.\
**Clowder:** your player team.\
**Strand:** one part of the campaign.\
**Token:** the reward proving you completed a Strand.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
**Seat:** right-click a Tension Post with a token.\
**Pulse:** the energy used by Tribal Power.\
You do not need to remember the lore to follow the instructions.
